scope: Independent reconstruction of all recorded provider/CodeQL literal facts, final validator and scoped tests, all 28 primary governing interpretations against cited originals, and truthful guide accounting. Mechanical cell fidelity and governing interpretation are distinct from legacy claim reconciliation, whole-artifact omission review and live deployment.

method: Read all selected provider YAML as data with an independent YAML-node reconstruction, preserving occurrence ordinal, original scalar and source line marks; independently reconstruct all ten Markdown query tables and full expected statement multisets without using the new validator parser.

Compare all 35,094 current typed claim IDs, exact statements, raw/display provider identities, labels, versions, field and definition spans, query help identities, CWE digit strings and icons/column meanings to original pinned bytes. Account for cloud conditional wording without altering context or coercing values.

Read all 28 governing propositions with every cited original span and neighboring context; verify all 33 source hashes/pins/line counts and all 60 span occurrences, including wrapper front matter and includes. This is a scoped proposition audit, not independent whole-artifact omission certification.
Read final validator, all 15 scoped tests, plan and both guides. Run the scoped suite and an additional independent temporary-third-document-read reproduction.

Independently rerun production validation against the retained original private inputs and compare the entire result object and all member IDs exactly to the bound verification report. Keep mechanical matches, 28 governing interpretations and unchanged 474 legacy receipts separately accounted.

resolved_findings.problem: Initial query parser assigned hardcoded column meanings while ignoring headers and unknown row shapes.
resolved_findings.resolution: Exact supported header/order, separator/wrapper and known row/link/icon/path shapes are required; duplicate lock repositories reject.
resolved_findings.verification: Swapped columns, contradictory icons, unknown rows, invalid wrapper/separator and pin mutation tests pass; all ten actual headers independently match.

resolved_findings.problem: Empty typed scope could produce passing zero-fact output.
resolved_findings.resolution: Empty typed scope and empty selected tables reject.
resolved_findings.verification: Empty scope regression passes; current exact scope remains 35094 claims.

resolved_findings.problem: Intermediate claim/artifact rereads were not immediately byte-bound, allowing temporary scope differences to escape endpoint checks.
resolved_findings.resolution: Second artifact/document reads must match their workload SHA; complete typed subject membership must match selected kinds before source comparison.
resolved_findings.verification: Both transient-read regressions pass; independent temporary third-read document truncation rejects before source pass.

resolved_findings.problem: Duplicate YAML key rejection used a different exception type from the new regression expectation.
resolved_findings.resolution: YAML parser errors are normalized to ValueError; duplicate keys and string booleans remain rejected.
resolved_findings.verification: Corrected scoped suite passes all 15 tests.

resolved_findings.problem: Private Autofix dependency lacked its exact supporting README span; URL high/critical suffixes were described as actual severity metadata.
resolved_findings.resolution: STG-022 adds README lines 87–89; STG-025 preserves URL suffixes and explicitly leaves actual severity unverified. Pinned-renderer wording avoids live UI certification.
resolved_findings.verification: All corrected statements and spans independently match pinned originals.

resolved_findings.problem: Initial remaining-work wording treated all 26,842 non-table records as lacking contextual decisions, including 474 existing receipts.
resolved_findings.resolution: Guide distinguishes 26,842 retained non-table records, 474 existing decisions and 26,368 currently unreconciled records, with source omissions separate.
resolved_findings.verification: Existing 474 IDs are disjoint from all 35,094 table IDs; corrected arithmetic and wording pass.

residual_limits: Provider field names use legacy public/private claim wording; pinned renderer interprets Partner/User alert. The README discrepancy is retained and contextualized, not erased or treated as current target coverage.
Literal Liquid values and absence remain distinct from evaluated booleans; full version/Liquid rendering and effective target entitlement are unmeasured.
